title: Compliance rows show the record; meterless services flag a reading
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset that has a customer, and a schedule to enrol it on. Seed them:
  3. ↳ Ensure a schedule exists (Settings > Maintenance > New schedule + at least one service).
  4. ↳ Open an asset that has a customer (from Customers > a customer > Assets, or from Work Orders) and open its Maintenance tab (the last tab on the asset page).
  5. Pick a schedule that includes a compliance service, a service watching a meter with no usable readings, a meter "At" already passed, and a calendar "At".
custom_steps:
1. Read a compliance service row in the modal.
  2. Read a row whose meter has no readings.
  3. Enrol and see how a meter "At" already passed, and a calendar "At", start their first cycle.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A compliance service shows its existing record's number and expiry, or "No record" with "+ Add record".
  • A service watching a meter with no usable readings carries a badge "Needs mileage reading" or "Needs engine hours reading"; the calendar date still shows.
  • A meter "At" already passed at enrolment shows what happened and offers Mark as done or Leave due (default done); a calendar "At" takes its next occurrence, counting today if that day has not passed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S7; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R6: “A compliance service will show its existing record's number and expiry, or No record with + Add record”
  • S7-R15: “Where a service watches a meter that has no usable readings, its row carries a badge naming the meter, Needs mileage reading or Needs engine hours reading ... The calendar date still shows”
  • S7-E1: “A meter At that has already been passed at enrolment shows what happened and offers Mark as done or Leave due. The default is done”
  • S7-E2: “A calendar At takes its next occurrence, counting today if that day has not passed”
